description: A one-to-eight switch with the output chosen by three gate inputs read as a binary number, and outputs that keep their last voltage when they are not the chosen one

inputs.text: The signal passed to whichever of the eight outputs the three gate inputs select
Adds 4 to the output number selected while it is above 1V
Adds 2 to the output number selected while it is above 1V
Adds 1 to the output number selected while it is above 1V

outputs.text: Carries IN while none of the three gate inputs is above 1V, and holds its last voltage at any other time
Carries IN while the OOX input is above 1V and the others are not, and holds its last voltage at any other time
Carries IN while the OXO input is above 1V and the others are not, and holds its last voltage at any other time
Carries IN while the OXO input and the OOX input are above 1V and the others are not, and holds its last voltage at any other time
Carries IN while the XOO input is above 1V and the others are not, and holds its last voltage at any other time
Carries IN while the XOO input and the OOX input are above 1V and the others are not, and holds its last voltage at any other time
Carries IN while the XOO input and the OXO input are above 1V and the others are not, and holds its last voltage at any other time
Carries IN while the XOO input, the OXO input and the OOX input are above 1V and the others are not, and holds its last voltage at any other time

notes: an output that stops being the chosen one does not fall to 0V; it stays at the voltage it had when it was last chosen, and reads 0V only until it has been chosen once.
with none of the three gate inputs patched the first output is selected, so IN goes straight through to it.

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
